inactive_hdr_parameters.sentinel_encoding: Non-finite inactive HDR defaults are preserved as explicit strings, not numbers or metric substitutes.

flip.note: Full-frame evaluator map is computed before ROI reduction; not HDR-FLIP.

definitions.rgb: Decoded 8-bit RGB PNG normalized to [0,1]; alpha excluded.
definitions.mse: Mean squared RGB channel difference in encoded sRGB; peak value 1 for PSNR.
definitions.smape: 100*mean(|Yref-Ytest|/(|Yref|+|Ytest|+1e-4)); Y=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B applied to encoded sRGB. This is display luma, not scene luminance.

limitations: PNG captures are tonemapped display images, not raw linear HDR radiance.
A regression comparison against B0 measures cross-version difference, not image accuracy against converged truth.
An accuracy_reference relation is a user declaration; reference convergence and scene/config parity require external evidence.
These display-space metrics are not paper-exact HDR SMAPE, MAPE, RelMSE or HDR-FLIP and do not establish unbiasedness.
